now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
now.text: Colonel Glenn Talbot hunts Phil Coulson and what is left of S.H.I.E.L.D., convinced they are a terrorist group.
now.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. leader Talbot hunts as a terrorist.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Colonel who hunts Coulson, convinced S.H.I.E.L.D. is a terrorist group.

changes.evidence: Talbot's hunt of Coulson starts in S1#18 'Providence': with S.H.I.E.L.D. declared a terrorist organization, Talbot calls Coulson at the Hub, says he is sending the Air Force to take it over, and Coulson takes his team on the run. The S1#20 raid on Providence is the hunt catching up with them, so the stage's text describes something that begins two episodes earlier.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#21
now.text: Melinda May is Daisy Johnson's supervising officer and trains her to fight. Over the years they become close friends who trust each other with their lives.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's trainer and supervising officer. They become close friends who trust each other with their lives.
now.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee. They become close friends who trust each other with their lives.

proposed.text: After Ward's betrayal, Melinda May talks with Skye about him and offers to be her new supervising officer, taking over her training.

changes.evidence: In S1#21 'Ragtag', after the team meeting, May and Skye talk about Ward and May offers to be Skye's new S.O. The current text's second sentence ('Over the years they become close friends who trust each other with their lives') sums up later seasons in a single episode's stage.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#21
now.text: On Garrett's orders, Grant Ward dumps Jemma and Fitz into the ocean.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra's Clairvoyant, who wins the team's trust, then has Jemma dumped in the ocean.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent of Coulson's Garrett has Ward dump in the ocean.

proposed.text: Garrett orders Grant Ward to kill Jemma and Fitz, and Ward ejects them into the ocean instead of shooting them.

changes.evidence: In S1#21 'Ragtag', the dying Garrett orders Ward to kill Fitz and Simmons. Ward cannot bring himself to shoot them and ejects their locked medical pod into the ocean instead. Garrett never orders them dumped in the ocean.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
now.text: When Grant Ward drops Jemma and Fitz into the ocean, Fury pulls them out and saves their lives, and she stays on to help rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D. as he asks.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The head of S.H.I.E.L.D., who pulls Jemma out of the ocean.
now.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's scientists, whom Fury pulls from the ocean.

proposed.text: Fury pulls Jemma and the unconscious Fitz out of the ocean. On his jet he tells her Fitz is alive, and she tells him where to find Coulson.

changes.evidence: In S1#22 'Beginning of the End', Fury picks up their distress call and rescues them. Simmons wakes in a hyperbaric chamber on his jet, Fury tells her Fitz is alive, and she tells him where to find Coulson. Fury never asks her to help rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D.: he asks Coulson to.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
now.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team during a deal, and in the fight she grabs the Obelisk with her bare hand. She survives losing the hand, but Creel then causes the car crash that kills her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent whose team Creel attacks. He causes the crash that kills her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Absorbing Man. Attacks Hartley's team and causes the crash that kills her.

proposed.text: Carl Creel kills Roger Browning during a deal with Isabelle Hartley's team, then attacks her again when she finds the Obelisk, and it infects her arm when she grabs it to defend herself. She survives losing the arm, but Creel then causes the car crash that kills her.

changes.evidence: In S2#1 'Shadows', Creel first kills Browning at the deal and escapes. Hartley touches the Obelisk later, at the Government Storage Warehouse, when Creel attacks her as she opens its case; Hunter cuts off her arm (not just the hand) on her orders before Creel flips their SUV. The current text puts the Obelisk grab in the fight at the deal.

owner_calls.question: The text and Hill's card line say Hill approved May's move to a desk job after Bahrain. That is only revealed in S2#17 'Melinda', but this stage sits at S1#20, and 'works in Hill's field office' has no on-screen source I could find. Does the backstory stay on this stage?
options: Cut the backstory: 'After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, May tracks down Hill to find out who ran Project T.A.H.I.T.I., the program that brought Coulson back.'
Add a stage at S2#17 for Hill approving the transfer
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU wiki cites Hill approving May's transfer request to AoS217 (S2#17). What happens between them in S1#20 is May confronting Hill about T.A.H.I.T.I.

owner_calls.question: The text says 'Fitz stays at his side' when Fury makes Coulson Director, but in S1#22 Fitz is brain-damaged and goes into a coma after nearly drowning. He is not with Coulson when the team reaches the Playground; Simmons only says he is alive. Fix the text here, or move the stage to S2#1, where Coulson keeps the withdrawn, brain-damaged Fitz on his team?
options: Keep at S1#22, text: 'Fury makes Coulson the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. while Fitz lies near death after nearly drowning.'
Move to S2#1, text: 'Coulson keeps Fitz on his team despite the brain damage that leaves him withdrawn, and has him working on cloaking for the Bus.'
owner_calls.evidence: Fury rescues Fitz and Simmons, and Fitz is left 'in a dire state' with a coma lasting nine days (S1#22). In S2#1 Coulson explains Fitz's brain damage to Mack and Koenig and has Fitz building cloaking tech.

owner_calls.question: This stage says Raina 'learns who Skye's father is' at S1#22, but she learns it from the hard drive in S1#21. Their first meeting is earlier still: S1#11 'The Magical Place', where Skye punches Raina to rescue Coulson and Raina is arrested. Move the stage, or add an earlier one?
options: Keep at S1#22 (Raina tells Ward chasing Skye matters most and brings Skye's photo to her father)
Add a rival/enemy stage at S1#11 for Skye knocking Raina out
owner_calls.evidence: Per the MCU wiki, Raina reads Skye's past on the hard drive and realizes Skye is the missing daughter of the man who took her in (AoS121). In AoS122 she tells Ward that chasing Skye matters more, and she delivers the photo. In AoS111 Skye punches Raina during Coulson's rescue.

owner_calls.question: Both card lines say 'They become close friends who trust each other with their lives', which describes later seasons on a one-stage S1#21 tie. Is that acceptable for card lines (wording final), or should a later stage carry it?
options: Add a later friend stage and trim the card lines
owner_calls.evidence: May offers to be Skye's S.O. in S1#21. Their close friendship develops over later seasons.
